claim_decisions.claim: Thompson first reported Thatcher illusion in Perception in 1980
claim_decisions.note: Full original article restricted; no fabricated direct quotes

claim_decisions.claim: Local eye/mouth inversion can look less conspicuous when entire face is inverted
claim_decisions.note: Do not assert every viewer sees identical effect

claim_decisions.claim: The illusion uniquely proves a specialized face-only mechanism
claim_decisions.note: 2010 tests included buildings, bicycles, cars, letter strings

claim_decisions.claim: 2007 study rotated observers on a 3D turntable at 0,45,90,135,180 degrees
claim_decisions.note: Do not invent numeric outcome

claim_decisions.claim: 2013 imaging found orientation-dependent adaptation effects in superior temporal sulcus
claim_decisions.note: Not a universal brain center

claim_decisions.claim: Thatcher illusion proves hypnosis, animal magnetism or meditation effectiveness
claim_decisions.note: No valid causal bridge

claim_decisions.claim: Puységur archive preserves testimony and failed predictions
claim_decisions.note: Historical record, not confirmation of magnetism
